fusions.name: Scrabbling Kick
fusions.desc: Rakes the target with a kick that deals 12 damage, knocks it back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Muster Stomp
fusions.desc: Stamps in a ring, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Long March
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises by 10% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Beaten Track
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 10%.
